about:
# Random Song
Adds two <cg>random song buttons</c> to the <cg>editor</c> when choosing a song:
- **<cg>Random Library Song</c>**: picks a random song from <cg>Geometry Dash's music library</c>.
- **<cg>Random Stored Song</c>**: picks a random song from your <cg>already downloaded songs</c>.

*You may disable automatic searching after clicking either of these buttons in the mod's settings.*

## Want to help?
Feel free to open a [Pull Request](https://github.com/M336G/RandomSong/pulls) on GitHub!
changelog:
# v1.1.0
- Added the "Use Local Library" setting; if disabled, song IDs will be fetched from an external API instead of your local musiclibrary.dat file
- Experimental iOS support; the "Use Local Library" setting is forced off on there as it uses the external API
    - Support is still limited however, as the random stored song button's behavior has not yet been implemented

# v1.0.2
- Experimental macOS support

# v1.0.1
- Fixed potential random crashes when parsing the musiclibrary.dat path to a string

# v1.0.0
- Initial release
